Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art animation sprite sheet for an existing side scrolling arcade game. The attached sheet is an IDENTITY, OUTFIT, COLOR, PIXEL STYLE and BODY SCALE reference only. Draw NEW poses for this exact character. True transparent background (alpha), no shadows, no backdrop, no text. Strict 6 columns x 4 rows =24 isolated poses, canvas1536x1024, each cell256x256. Face RIGHT in every cell. Body centered localx128, grounded feet at localy244, standing height210px. Everything including weapons and trails must fit in its cell, 8px margins. Crisp hand-placed pixel clusters, detailed 1990s arcade style, consistent anatomy and identity. Exact frame sequence row-major: frames0-7 are EIGHT sequential forward SPRINT cycle poses (lean torso forward, running not walking, alternating contact/recoil/passing/flight, scarf/cape trailing). Frames8-11 are FOUR distinct windup poses transitioning from sprint into the attack. Frames12-17 are SIX strong active attack poses performing ACTION below, fully extended at12 and13, then followthrough; all action directed RIGHT, sparse short colored trails contained within cell. Frames18-23 are SIX braking and recovery poses, plant front foot, regain balance and return to guard. No jumping high, no idle repeats in the sprint. One character per cell. Match reference size so animation connects to existing sprites.
Character: KAGURA, adult Japanese male samurai with navy ponytail, red scarf, sleeveless black red-trimmed gi, katana.
ACTION: a low running horizontal katana cleave, red-orange crescent slash.
